title: Design System: Warta Pemerintah Modern — Kampung Sapen

display.purpose: Featured and article headlines in local Atkinson Hyperlegible.

body.purpose: All public interface and reading copy; local Atkinson Hyperlegible.

shadows.name: featured-hover
shadows.purpose: Subtle feedback when the featured story is hovered.

shadows.name: login-dialog
shadows.purpose: Separate the admin login dialog from its page overlay.

motion.name: news-link-feedback
motion.purpose: Quiet hover feedback for the featured story.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Remove nonessential transition duration when requested by the system.

components.name: Public Masthead
components.description: Compact portal mark with the search field as the primary public utility.
components.html: Warta Sapen
components.css: .ds-masthead { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 12px; color: #17345f; background: #fff; border-bottom: 1px solid #d7dee8; font: 800 18px/1.3 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-mark { width: 40px; height: 40px; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 5px; color: #fff; background: #17345f; } .ds-mark svg { width: 22px; height: 22px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.7; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-masthead input { flex: 1; min-width: 0; height: 46px; margin-left: auto; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid #aeb9c8; border-radius: 5px; color: #172335; background: #fff; font: 400 16px/1.4 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-masthead input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #1d4ed8; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: A clear, minimal action used for loading more news or submitting the admin login.
components.css: .ds-primary { min-height: 46px; padding: 9px 20px; border: 1px solid #1a427e; border-radius: 5px; color: #fff; background: #2458a6; font: 800 16px/1.4 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .16s ease; } .ds-primary:hover { background: #1a427e; } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #1d4ed8; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-primary:disabled { opacity: .65; cursor: wait; }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: Full-width, high-contrast entry for searching news and announcements.
components.html: <label class="ds-label" for="ds-search">Cari berita</label><input class="ds-search" id="ds-search" placeholder="Cari berita atau pengumuman" />
components.css: .ds-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 6px; color: #263951; font: 700 14px/1.4 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-search { width: 100%; min-height: 46px; padding: 9px 12px; border: 1px solid #aeb9c8; border-radius: 5px; color: #172335; background: #fff; font: 400 16px/1.4 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-search::placeholder { color: #536277; opacity: 1; } .ds-search:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #1d4ed8; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Category Chip
components.description: A compact category filter; selected state uses institutional navy.
components.css: .ds-chip { min-height: 38px; padding: 7px 13px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 5px; color: #34465d; background: transparent; font: 700 15px/1.4 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip:hover { color: #17345f; background: #edf3fb; } .ds-chip[aria-pressed='true'] { border-color: #17345f; color: #fff; background: #17345f; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #1d4ed8; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Featured Story
components.description: One prominent current article; image and headline lead without promotional decoration.
components.html: Pengumuman · 25 November 2026Berita utama Kampung SapenBaca berita →
components.css: .ds-featured { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.1fr .9fr; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid #d7dee8; border-radius: 7px; color: #172335; background: #f3f6fa; text-decoration: none; transition: border-color .16s ease, box-shadow .16s ease; } .ds-featured:hover { border-color: #91a8c8; box-shadow: 0 5px 18px rgb(23 52 95 / 9%); } .ds-featured img { width: 100%; height: 100%; min-height: 280px; object-fit: cover; } .ds-featured > span { display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; align-items: flex-start; gap: 14px; padding: 24px; } .ds-featured small { color: #1a427e; font: 800 13px/1.4 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-featured strong { color: #122744; font: 800 30px/1.2 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-featured b { color: #1a427e; font: 800 15px/1.4 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-featured:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #1d4ed8; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Compact News Row
components.description: Secondary story row with a left thumbnail, three-line headline, and one metadata line.
components.html: Berita kegiatan warga Kampung SapenPengumuman · 25 November 2026
components.css: .ds-news-row { min-height: 100px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 88px minmax(0,1fr); align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 12px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #d7dee8; color: #172335; text-decoration: none; } .ds-news-row img { width: 88px; height: 72px; border-radius: 4px; object-fit: cover; } .ds-news-row > span { min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 7px; } .ds-news-row strong { display: -webkit-box; overflow: hidden; color: #172d4a; font: 800 16px/1.28 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', Arial, sans-serif; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; -webkit-line-clamp: 3; } .ds-news-row small { overflow: hidden; color: #48586c; font: 700 12px/1.3 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', Arial, sans-serif; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-news-row:hover strong { color: #1a427e; } .ds-news-row:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #1d4ed8; outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
The portal is a concise public information desk for Kampung Sapen. Its interface puts the publication name, search, category filters, and current story in a predictable reading order. White space, navy headings, and royal-blue controls create institutional clarity while Atkinson Hyperlegible keeps the Indonesian copy easy to distinguish.

The visual voice is factual and restrained. Story imagery supplies the human warmth; the interface stays quiet so residents can read and search without competing service dashboards, promotional calls to action, or decorative motion.
keyCharacteristics: White and cool-gray reading surfaces with navy structure and royal-blue actions.
Atkinson Hyperlegible across interface and article text.
Thin rules and restrained corners instead of stacked decorative cards.

rules.name: The Quiet Interface Rule
rules.body: Use color to identify hierarchy, links, selection, and focus; do not turn every section into a colored block.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Use the locally bundled Atkinson Hyperlegible face throughout public reading surfaces.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Reserve shadows for interaction or a modal that must sit above page content.

dos: Do keep search and current news at the top of the first mobile viewport.
Do preserve clear contrast, visible keyboard focus, and readable category/date metadata.
Do use white, cool gray, navy, and royal blue as the system palette.
Do let story imagery provide personality while the interface stays quiet.
donts: Don't add dashboard metrics, service panels, a game, ticker, slider, map embed, or oversized calls to action to the public homepage.
Don't add financial balance widgets or the village information editor to the reading flow.
Don't add excerpts to compact news-list rows.
Don't use decorative gradients, emoji, or motion that competes with reading.
